Terminal & Shell tutorial

xdg-terminal-exec on Omarchy

Lets apps open 'the terminal' without guessing which one.

Package data synced 2026-10-17 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install xdg-terminal-exec on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add xdg-terminal-exec. It is a 22 KB download (47.7 KB installed), version 0.14.3-1, licensed GPL-3.0-or-later. Proposed standard to launching desktop apps with Terminal=true. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install xdg-terminal-exec on Omarchy

xdg-terminal-exec is a reference implementation of a proposed freedesktop.org standard for launching a user's preferred terminal emulator, the same way xdg-open resolves a preferred browser or file handler. Instead of a script or app hard-coding a specific terminal, it calls xdg-terminal-exec and the system resolves whichever terminal the user has configured, optionally running a command inside it.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add xdg-terminal-exec
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.14.3-1:
    pacman -Qi xdg-terminal-exec

Open and use xdg-terminal-exec

xdg-terminal-exec has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql xdg-terminal-exec | grep /usr/bin/

xdg-terminal-exec requirements and compatibility

  • Terminal emulators need a compatible desktop entry (TerminalEmulator category with an X-TerminalArgExec key) to be selectable

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL-3.0-or-later.

Uninstall xdg-terminal-exec

omarchy pkg drop xdg-terminal-exec

Frequently asked questions

How do I install xdg-terminal-exec on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add xdg-terminal-exec. The download is 22 KB and it takes 47.7 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is xdg-terminal-exec free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later.

How do I uninstall xdg-terminal-exec?

Run omarchy pkg drop xdg-terminal-exec. It removes the package from your system.

What does xdg-terminal-exec depend on?

xdg-terminal-exec declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is xdg-terminal-exec a desktop app?

No. xdg-terminal-exec has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is xdg-terminal-exec in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as xdg-terminal-exec (version 0.14.3-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Vladimir-csp makes it. Project site: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/Vladimir-csp/xdg-terminal-exec.
